mapper.select: SELECT CMN_CHNL.CHNL_SEQ , CMN_CHNL.CHNL_CD , CMN_CHNL.USE_YN , CMN_CHNL.CHNL_NM , CMN_CHNL.CHNL_IP , CMN_CHNL.CHNL_PORT , CMN_CHNL.CHNL_DMN , CMN_CHNL.CHNL_BSC_URI , CMN_CHNL.CHNL_DESC , TO_CHAR(CMN_CHNL.RGST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS RGST_DT , CMN_CHNL.RGST_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = CMN_CHNL.RGST_SEQ ) AS RGST_NM , TO_CHAR(CMN_CHNL.UPDT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS UPDT_DT , CMN_CHNL.UPDT_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = CMN_CHNL.UPDT_SEQ ) AS UPDT_NM FROM CMN_CHNL_INFO_TBL CMN_CHNL WHERE 1 = 1 AND (((#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (CMN_CHNL.USE_YN = #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{chnlSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL) OR (#{chnlSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} = 0)) OR (CMN_CHNL.CHNL_SEQ = #{chnlSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC})) AND (((#{chnlCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{chnlCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (CMN_CHNL.CHNL_CD = #{chnlCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{chnlNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{chnlNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (CMN_CHNL.CHNL_NM LIKE '%' || #{chnlNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'))

SELECT CMN_CHNL.CHNL_SEQ , CMN_CHNL.CHNL_CD , CMN_CHNL.USE_YN , CMN_CHNL.CHNL_NM , CMN_CHNL.CHNL_IP , CMN_CHNL.CHNL_PORT , CMN_CHNL.CHNL_DMN , CMN_CHNL.CHNL_BSC_URI , CMN_CHNL.CHNL_DESC , TO_CHAR(CMN_CHNL.RGST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS RGST_DT , CMN_CHNL.RGST_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = CMN_CHNL.RGST_SEQ ) AS RGST_NM , TO_CHAR(CMN_CHNL.UPDT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS UPDT_DT , CMN_CHNL.UPDT_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = CMN_CHNL.UPDT_SEQ ) AS UPDT_NM FROM CMN_CHNL_INFO_TBL CMN_CHNL WHERE 1 = 1 AND (((#{chnlSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL) OR (#{chnlSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} = 0)) OR (CMN_CHNL.CHNL_SEQ = #{chnlSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC})) AND (((#{chnlCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{chnlCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (CMN_CHNL.CHNL_CD = #{chnlCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}))
